text:
maria (support): FYI new PinePeak trial — console shows an API key was created but the customer gets 403s when calling the API: 'Invalid project scope'. Can someone take a look?

provisioner-bot: provisioner.completed claim_id=clm_7f2b project=proj-deprecated-123 org=org-removed-987 status=bound key_id=key_01a2 

kevin (infra): copying logs — provisioner bound the claim to proj-deprecated-123. That project was soft-deleted during an org cleanup 2h earlier, looks like the worker picked the stale project id.

kevin (infra): quick repro from my side:
```bash
# using the API key the console shows
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer key_01a2" \\  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions -d '{"model":"gpt-test","input":"hi"}' | jq .
{
  "error": {
    "message": "Invalid project scope: project not active",
    "status": 403
  }
}
```

emma (support-engineer): ugh. So the key exists but the authorization layer rejects because the project lookup returns 404/archived. Any workaround to get the customer unblocked quickly?

kevin (infra): short-term: rebind the claim to an active project for the org. I have a small helper script: `tools/rebind_claim.sh <claim_id> <target_project>` which patches the claim and refreshes caches. Steps I ran locally: 
1) stop provisioning-worker (to avoid race)
2) run `./tools/rebind_claim.sh clm_7f2b proj-active-456`
3) restart provisioning-worker
4) run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer key_01a2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions` to verify

kevin (infra): script output excerpt: 
```
INFO rebind: claim clm_7f2b -> proj-active-456
PATCH /internal/claims/clm_7f2b {"project":"proj-active-456"} -> 200
INFO cache: invalidating claim cache for clm_7f2b
```

maria (support): I ran the script and restarted the worker for PinePeak (customer id: cust_pinepeak). Customer retried and now gets 200s. They reported latency is fine and keys working.

emma (support-engineer): nice. Can we add a safety check in the provisioner so it refuses to bind to soft-deleted projects? Filed GH: infra/provisioner#412 with suggested guard.

kevin (infra): +1. I'll follow up — adding a prebind validation and a metrics alert when a bind references a project state != active.

maria (support): customer confirmed resolution and asked for a short postmortem. I'll send notes to the account team. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
